%1$s stores saved computer metadata locally. Temporary direct-connect credentials, Console sessions, and tokens are encrypted with Android Keystore-backed keys. Console traffic requires verified HTTPS; a private-network direct connection may use unencrypted HTTP and WebSocket traffic on that local network.

Microphone access starts only after you initiate a voice call and grant Android permission. Clipboard, file transfer, recording, and diagnostic sharing run only after an explicit action. Temporary files are kept in app-private cache and expire automatically. A diagnostic report contains build/device information and recent application logs with common credentials, URLs, addresses, and identifiers redacted; Android shows the destination chooser before anything leaves the device.

%1$s does not include advertising or analytics SDKs and does not sell personal data. Removing app data deletes locally stored account sessions, devices, and temporary files.
